english: Tap the camera to scan your first document.
target: Ketuk kamera untuk memindai dokumen pertama Anda.
backtrans: Tap the camera to scan your first document.

target: Satu gambar per halaman, tanpa kehilangan kualitas
backtrans: One image per page, without loss of quality

english: Documents inside will not be deleted.
target: Dokumen di dalamnya tidak akan dihapus.
backtrans: The documents inside it will not be deleted.
Delete from folder [??: 'Hapus' means delete rather than 'remove'; may mislead]

english: No documents in this folder yet.
target: Belum ada dokumen di folder ini.
backtrans: There are no documents in this folder yet.

english: This folder is no longer available.
backtrans: This folder is no longer available.

english: This isn't automatic sync. Export creates a single encrypted backup file you move to your new device yourself, then import there.
target: Ini bukan sinkronisasi otomatis. Ekspor membuat satu file cadangan terenkripsi yang Anda pindahkan sendiri ke perangkat baru, lalu impor di sana.
backtrans: This is not automatic synchronization. Export creates one encrypted backup file that you move yourself to the new device, then import there.

english: Could not import this backup. Check the password and try again.
target: Tidak dapat mengimpor cadangan ini. Periksa kata sandi dan coba lagi.
backtrans: Unable to import this backup. Check the password and try again.
This backup file seems to be corrupted.

english: {count, plural, =1{1 document imported} other{{count} documents imported}}
target: {count, plural, =1{1 dokumen diimpor} other{{count} dokumen diimpor}}
backtrans: {count, plural, =1{1 document imported} other{{count} documents imported}}

english: Pricing is still loading — try again in a moment.
target: Harga masih dimuat — coba lagi sebentar.
backtrans: Prices are still loading — try again in a moment.

english: This scan is no longer available.
backtrans: This scan is no longer available.

english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
backtrans: An error occurred. Please try again.

english: This will undo all filters, rotations, crops, resizes, and eraser strokes on this page.
target: Ini akan membatalkan semua filter, rotasi, pemotongan, perubahan ukuran, dan sapuan penghapus pada halaman ini.
backtrans: This will cancel all filters, rotations, cuts, size changes, and eraser strokes on this page.

english: Front side captured. Now capture the back side.
target: Sisi depan diambil. Sekarang ambil sisi belakang.
backtrans: Front side captured. Now capture the back side.

english: Use your saved signature or draw a new one?
target: Gunakan tanda tangan tersimpan atau gambar yang baru?
backtrans: Use a saved signature or draw a new one?

english: No documents to batch export. Scan some first.
target: Tidak ada dokumen untuk ekspor massal. Pindai beberapa terlebih dahulu.
backtrans: No documents for mass export. Scan some first.

english: No folders yet. Create one from the home screen.
target: Belum ada folder. Buat satu dari layar beranda.
backtrans: No folders yet. Make one from the home screen.

target: {count, plural, =0{Tidak ada halaman} =1{1 halaman} other{{count} halaman}}

english: Copy text to clipboard after scan
target: Salin teks ke papan klip setelah memindai
backtrans: Copy text to the clipboard after scanning
Play a sound when scanning is finished

target: Umpan balik haptik saat pemindaian selesai
backtrans: Haptic feedback when scanning is finished

target: {count, plural, =0{Tidak ada entri} =1{1 entri} other{{count} entri}}

english: DOCX sources render poorly as pages — save inside the app is limited to JPG/PNG from image, PDF, TXT or CSV sources. Use Export & Share for this file.
target: Sumber DOCX tidak dapat ditampilkan dengan baik sebagai halaman — penyimpanan dalam aplikasi terbatas pada JPG/PNG dari gambar, PDF, TXT, atau CSV. Gunakan Ekspor & bagikan untuk file ini.
backtrans: DOCX source cannot be displayed well as pages — in-app saving is limited to JPG/PNG from images, PDF, TXT, or CSV. Use Export & share for this file.

english: To save inside the app, choose JPG or PNG. Other targets are exported as files.
target: Untuk menyimpan di dalam aplikasi, pilih JPG atau PNG. Target lain diekspor sebagai file.
backtrans: To save inside the app, choose JPG or PNG. Other targets are exported as files.
Edit watermark [??: 'tanda air' is literally 'water mark']

target: Ekspor massal — penempatan tanda tangan dinonaktifkan

english: Tap a spot to sample its color
target: Ketuk titik untuk mengambil sampel warna
backtrans: Tap a point to take a color sample
Take a color sample from the page
Delete selected area [??: 'Hapus' delete vs erase]

target: {count, plural, =0{Tidak ada yang ditempatkan} =1{1 ditempatkan} other{{count} ditempatkan}}
OCR tidak tersedia di perangkat ini.
backtrans: OCR is not available on this device.

english: Your device doesn't support the advanced document scanner. Take a photo with your Camera app, then tap Import below to crop and save it.
target: Perangkat Anda tidak mendukung pemindai dokumen canggih. Ambil foto dengan aplikasi Kamera, lalu ketuk Impor di bawah untuk memotong dan menyimpannya.
backtrans: Your device does not support the advanced document scanner. Take a photo with the Camera app, then tap Import below to cut and save it.

target: Penagihan tidak tersedia — coba lagi nanti.
backtrans: Billing is not available — try again later.

english: No internet. Connect once to download the language pack.
target: Tidak ada internet. Hubungkan sekali untuk mengunduh paket bahasa.
backtrans: No internet. Connect once to download the language pack.

english: Language pack downloading or not ready. Try again shortly.
target: Paket bahasa sedang diunduh atau belum siap. Coba lagi sebentar.
backtrans: The language pack is being downloaded or is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
Repeat [??: 'Ulangi' means repeat, redo is usually 'Ulangi' too; ambiguous]

english: YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
target: DOKUMEN ANDA TETAP DI PERANGKAT ANDA
backtrans: YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE

english: Your entire document office — scan, edit, sign, and export — in one private app.
target: Kantor dokumen lengkap Anda — pindai, edit, tanda tangani, ekspor — dalam satu aplikasi pribadi.
backtrans: Your complete document office — scan, edit, sign, export — in one private app. [??: 'Kantor' means office (workplace); likely intended 'office suite']

english: Annotate, sign, watermark, fill forms, seal, and more — every tool free and unlimited.
target: Anotasi, tanda tangan, tanda air, isi formulir, stempel, dan lainnya — semuanya gratis dan tanpa batas.
backtrans: Annotation, signature, watermark, fill forms, stamps, and more — all free and unlimited.

english: Use KatharScan in {count} languages. OCR runs on your phone — nothing ever leaves your device.
target: Gunakan KatharScan dalam {count} bahasa. OCR berjalan di ponsel Anda — tidak ada yang meninggalkan perangkat.
backtrans: Use KatharScan in {count} languages. OCR runs on your phone — nothing leaves the device.

english: E-sign contracts, type-to-fill forms, and stamp enterprise seals in seconds.
target: Tanda tangani kontrak secara elektronik, isi formulir, stempel perusahaan dalam hitungan detik.
backtrans: Sign contracts electronically, fill forms, company stamps within seconds.

english: Every edit stays reversible — undo, redo, and revert to original anytime.
target: Setiap edit dapat dibatalkan — urungkan, ulangi, kembalikan ke asli kapan saja.
backtrans: Every edit can be canceled — undo, repeat, return to original at any time.

english: No account, no cloud, no watermarks. Your documents never leave your device.
target: Tanpa akun, tanpa cloud, tanpa tanda air. Dokumen Anda tidak pernah meninggalkan perangkat.
backtrans: No account, no cloud, no watermark. Your documents never leave the device.

english: Support KatharScan with a one-time purchase. All features remain free.
target: Dukung KatharScan dengan pembelian sekali. Semua fitur tetap gratis.
backtrans: Support KatharScan with a one-time purchase. All features remain free.

english: This is a non-consumable purchase. Restore it anytime on any device with the same store account.
target: Ini adalah pembelian non-habis pakai. Pulihkan kapan saja di perangkat mana pun dengan akun toko yang sama.
backtrans: This is a non-consumable purchase. Restore at any time on any device with the same store account.

english: KatharScan ran into a problem displaying this screen. Your scans are safe — they're stored on this device and this doesn't affect them.
target: KatharScan mengalami masalah saat menampilkan layar ini. Pindaian Anda aman — disimpan di perangkat ini dan tidak terpengaruh.
backtrans: KatharScan ran into a problem while displaying this screen. Your scans are safe — stored on this device and unaffected.

target: Tidak ada pindaian yang cocok dengan pencarian Anda.

english: No folders yet. Tap the folder icon to create one.
target: Belum ada folder. Ketuk ikon folder untuk membuat satu.
backtrans: No folders yet. Tap the folder icon to make one.

english: No favorites yet. Tap the star icon on a document to add it.
target: Belum ada favorit. Ketuk ikon bintang pada dokumen untuk menambahkannya.
backtrans: No favorites yet. Tap the star icon on a document to add it.

target: Pemindaian ID dua sisi: Depan + Belakang

english: Share it with friends who need a powerful document scanner.
target: Bagikan dengan teman yang membutuhkan pemindai dokumen canggih.
backtrans: Share with friends who need an advanced document scanner.

english: Your feedback helps us grow and keeps the app free.
target: Ulasan Anda membantu kami berkembang dan menjaga aplikasi tetap gratis.
backtrans: Your review helps us grow and keep the app free.

english: Welcome to KatharScan! This is the first public release featuring unlimited scanning, 29 languages, and export to PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG, and CSV.
target: Selamat datang di KatharScan! Ini adalah rilis publik pertama dengan pemindaian tanpa batas, 29 bahasa, dan ekspor ke PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG, dan CSV.
backtrans: Welcome to KatharScan! This is the first public release with unlimited scanning, 29 languages, and export to PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG, and CSV.

english: Allow background reminders for unexported documents
target: Izinkan pengingat latar belakang untuk dokumen yang belum diekspor
backtrans: Allow background reminders for documents that have not been exported

english: Allow the app to occasionally ask for a rating
backtrans: Allow the app to occasionally ask for a rating

english: Allow the app to occasionally suggest sharing
backtrans: Allow the app to occasionally suggest sharing

english: The pages could not be attached to the email. Use Share to send the pages.
target: Halaman tidak dapat dilampirkan ke email. Gunakan Bagikan untuk mengirim halaman.
backtrans: The page cannot be attached to the email. Use Share to send the page.

english: This document has no text yet. Run OCR on it first.
target: Dokumen ini belum memiliki teks. Jalankan OCR terlebih dahulu.
backtrans: This document does not have text yet. Run OCR first.

english: Your latest changes could not be saved.
target: Perubahan terbaru Anda tidak dapat disimpan.
backtrans: Your latest changes could not be saved.

english: Tap the page where you want to type
target: Ketuk halaman di tempat Anda ingin mengetik
backtrans: Tap the page where you want to type

english: This PDF has {count} pages. Pages that are pictures are read with OCR (about 10 seconds each); pages with real text are instant.
target: PDF ini memiliki {count} halaman. Halaman berupa gambar dibaca dengan OCR (sekitar 10 detik per halaman); halaman teks asli instan.
backtrans: This PDF has {count} pages. Image pages are read with OCR (about 10 seconds per page); native text pages are instant.

english: Draw or type a new one
backtrans: Draw or type a new one

english: Check the pages (the document has {count} pages)
backtrans: Check the pages (the document has {count} pages)

english: Couldn't find the page edges. Drag the corners.
target: Tepi halaman tidak ditemukan. Seret sudutnya.
backtrans: Page edges not found. Drag the corners.

english: Enlarging doesn't add detail — the page may look soft.
target: Memperbesar tidak menambah detail — halaman bisa tampak buram.
backtrans: Enlarging does not add detail — the page may look blurry.

english: Delete {count} pages? They are removed when you save.
target: Hapus {count} halaman? Dihapus saat Anda menyimpan.
backtrans: Delete {count} pages? Deleted when you save.

english: Could not get under {mb} MB; sent the smallest version.
target: Tidak dapat diperkecil hingga di bawah {mb} MB; versi terkecil dikirim.
backtrans: Cannot be reduced to below {mb} MB; the smallest version was sent.
